thread:
maya_cs: quick heads-up — ArtemisHealth private deployment cutover stalled. Two items surfaced in smoke: 1) Flow logs and audit stream not appearing in customer's S3 (they see zero objects) 2) KMS decrypt errors when our snapshot service tries to mount EBS -> mounts fail, replicas not ready. customer called today, renewal sentiment cooled. :frowning:
diego_net: noted. can you paste the forwarder role ARN and the VPC endpoint IDs? also any recent flowlog status?
maya_cs: role arn: arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/redwood-arth-smoke-forwarder, vpce-07a3b2c1, vpce-09d8c7b6. flowlogs: status ACTIVE but lastDeliveryTime null according to console.
anika_sec: KMS errors could be policy or missing grants. what's the KMS key id/alias? any recent key rotation?
maya_cs: alias: alias/redwood/arth-logs. customer rotated keys last week but said they were told cross-account grants preserved.
diego_net: let's validate flow logs from our side first. do we see VPC endpoint connectivity e.g. traceroute from forwarder to s3 endpoint? run inside pod and paste output.
maya_cs: will run exec and post. Deploy-bot: smoke-check triggered for ArtemisHealth at 2025-02-03T14:04:28Z
deploy-bot: smoke-check: forwarder-health=FAIL, snapshot-mount=FAIL

maya_cs: exec output (scrubbed):
```
# kubectl exec -it forwarder-0 -- curl -sS 169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/placement/availability-zone
us-west-2a
# nslookup s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
Server: 10.0.0.2
Address: 10.0.0.2#53
Name: s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
Address: 52.216.10.45
```

anika_sec: that looks ok for DNS. check VPC endpoint policy on the S3 VPC endpoint — if policy denies PutObject/PutObjectAcl we wouldn't get flow logs delivered to bucket. ask customer to paste endpoint policy.
diego_net: also confirm route table for subnets has the endpoint target (com.amazonaws.us-west-2.s3) and not a NAT gateway. if traffic is going through NAT, flow logs delivery behaves differently.
maya_cs: asked customer to share endpoint policy and route tables, they responded they're attaching an SCP that might be blocking cross-account PutObject. will paste shortly.
kms-bot: kms-alert: Decrypt fails for key alias/redwood/arth-logs with error: AccessDeniedException (context: "User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource")
anika_sec: that's the exact error we needed. likely either the key policy lacks the cross-account principal or an explicit Deny in SCP. maya — please ask customer to run aws iam simulate-principal-policy against the role and include kms:Decrypt in eval.
maya_cs: requested simulate-principal-policy output. noted renewal risk—CS notes customer may pause cutover if we can't guarantee audit retention and snapshot integrity. tier=high if unresolved >48h. :rotating_light:
diego_net: action items: 1) customer to share S3 VPC endpoint policy + route tables 2) customer to run iam simulate on forwarder role for kms:Decrypt 3) anika to propose minimal key policy snippet to allow cross-account decrypt (I'll paste a template) 4) maya to set up joint troubleshooting call tomorrow 10:00 PT.
anika_sec: template snippet I'll send privately in call but quick example (one-liner):
```
KeyPolicy: allow principal arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/redwood-arth-smoke-forwarder to kms:Decrypt,kms:DescribeKey
```
maya_cs: thanks. ping me when you have the snippet. I've looped AE and renewal lead. I'll attach logs and the simulate output when available.
diego_net: ack. will stand by for route table and endpoint policy.
kms-bot: runbook triggered: "priv-onboard/kms-crossaccount-check" assigned to @anika_sec
maya_cs: adding customer feedback for onboarding docs: include a "pre-cutover checks" checklist with: confirm endpoint policy, confirm key policy/grants, verify flow logs delivery path, and a brief run command set for forwarder debug. filing doc request. :memo:
